CloudAssistant.description_zh: 实例命令助手安装状态结果集合

ActiveTaskCount.description_en: The number of active tasks in Command Assistant
ActiveTaskCount.description_zh: 实例内的命令助手运行中的任务数

CloudAssistantStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether Command Assistant is running. Valid values:

true: Heartbeats are detected in the last 2 minutes.

false: Heartbeats are not detected in the last 2 minutes
CloudAssistantStatus.description_zh:
实例内的命令助手是否在运行中。可能值：

true：2 分钟内有心跳。

false：2 分钟内无心跳

CloudAssistantVersion.description_en: The version number of the Command Assistant agent. Null is returned if the Command Assistant agent is not installed or is not running
CloudAssistantVersion.description_zh: 命令助手Agent版本号，若未安装或未运行命令助手Agent，则该值为空

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the simple application server

InvocationCount.description_en: The number of completed tasks in Command Assistant
InvocationCount.description_zh: 实例内的命令助手已完成的任务数

LastHeartbeatTime.description_en: The time when the last heartbeat of Command Assistant was detected. The value is updated every minute on average. The interval can be 55, 60, or 65 seconds
LastHeartbeatTime.description_zh: 命令助手最近一次心跳时间。该值平均每分钟（有上下 5 秒的随机浮动，最短 55 秒，最长 65 秒）更新一次

LastInvokedTime.description_en: The time when commands were last run
LastInvokedTime.description_zh: 最近一次命令执行的时间

OSType.description_en:
The OS type of the simple application server. Valid values:

Windows

Linux

FreeBSD
OSType.description_zh:
实例操作系统类型。可能值：

Windows。
Linux。
FreeBSD

SupportSessionManager.description_en:
Indicates whether Command Assistant supports session management. If Command Assistant does not support session management, the version of the Command Assistant agent is too earlier. We recommend that you update your Command Assistant agent to the latest version.

To use the session management feature, you must make sure that the version of your Command Assistant agent meets one of the following requirements:

If your simple application server runs Linux, the version of the Command Assistant agent on the server must be 2.2.3.189 or later. If your simple application server runs Windows, the version of the Command Assistant agent on the server must be 2.1.3.189 or later
SupportSessionManager.description_zh:
实例内的命令助手是否支持会话管理功能。若不支持，表示命令助手版本较低，请将客户端更新至最新版本。

命令助手支持会话管理功能的最低版本如下：

Linux：2.2.3.189
Windows：2.1.3.189

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
